Spyglass.Settings.Category.Description: XAML hot reload for running Avalonia apps.
Spyglass.Settings.HotReloadEnabled: Send unsaved .axaml edits to running apps
Spyglass.Settings.HotReloadDelay: Milliseconds without typing before an edit is sent (0 = only on save)
Spyglass.Settings.Command: Command used to start `spyglass serve` (an executable or Spyglass.dll)
Spyglass.Settings.AutoStart: Start `spyglass serve` when no Spyglass is running
Spyglass.Settings.PreviewEnabled: Enable the design-time preview of the active .axaml (Extensions › Spyglass › Open Preview)
Spyglass.Settings.PreviewDelay: Milliseconds without typing before the preview updates
Spyglass.Settings.PreviewAutoOpen: Open the preview window automatically when an .axaml file is opened
Spyglass.Settings.PreviewZoom: Preview zoom: fit, or a percentage such as 100%
Spyglass.Settings.PreviewTheme: Preview theme variant for Window roots: default, light or dark
